# A name the import has to change is changed once and said: a field named
# for a keyword, two keys one camelCase name, two schemas one declaration
# name, an enum member, and a parameter named like one of the adapter's own
# props, and a component named like a schema but for its first letter, which
# Go would export as one identifier. The program reads each by the name the
# warning gives.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

sngl check app.sngl
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": thing is declared as Thing2: Thing is taken or reserved'
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": field for of Thing is for_'
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": field pageCount of Thing is pageCount2'
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": member "a-b" of ThingKind is aB2'
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": parameter value of GET /things is value2'
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": listThings is declared as listThings2: the name is taken or reserved'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import api "openapi:./api.yml"

func read(t api.Thing, u api.Thing2) string {
    return "{t.for_} {t.pageCount} {t.pageCount2} {u.a}"
}

func kinds() list[api.ThingKind] {
    return [api.ThingKind.aB, api.ThingKind.aB2]
}

component page ui.node {
    var got option[list[api.Thing]] = null
    api.listThings2(value2="x", :value=got)
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    page
}
-- api.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
servers:
- url: https://api.example
paths:
  /things:
    get:
      operationId: listThings
      parameters:
      - {name: value, in: query, required: true, schema: {type: string}}
      responses:
        '200': {description: '', content: {application/json: {schema: {type: array, items: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Thing'}}}}}
components:
  schemas:
    Thing:
      type: object
      properties:
        for: {type: string}
        page_count: {type: string}
        pageCount: {type: string}
        kind: {type: string, enum: [aB, a-b]}
    thing:
      type: object
      properties:
        a: {type: string}
    ListThings:
      type: object
      properties:
        n: {type: integer}
